contracts: equal-process average conditional mean using the exact bounded-chord denominator
predictably weighted average conditional mean using the conservative weighted denominator
joint_optimization.constraint: For every design point under both contracts, cross no later than both the baseline mixture and R times the per-scenario best single-lambda oracle.

equal_process_results.interpretation: No material regression was observed; the tiny positive values are root/LP numerical tolerance, not a claimed analytic continuum proof.

predictably_weighted_results.interpretation: No material regression was observed; the residual is numerical tolerance at the high-score edge.

weighted_contract.weight_requirement: 0<w_i<=1 and w_i must be fixed before the current cluster outcome is observed
proof_outline: convexity: E exp(-lambda w_i Y_i) <= 1-(1-exp(-lambda w_i))*mu_i
the proposed component at the true weighted average is pathwise dominated by the corresponding nonnegative supermartingale; fixed mixtures inherit Ville validity

measurement_boundary.equal_process: Unequal process sizes do not affect the equal-process estimand if each process contributes exactly one bounded score.
measurement_boundary.request_weighted: Request/exposure weighting is a different estimand. Realized process size is not a valid weight by default if it can depend on the current outcome.
measurement_boundary.preferred_design_when_possible: Prospectively fixed equal-size exposure blocks avoid retrospective size weighting and can use the tighter equal-weight construction even when blocks are dependent across time.
measurement_boundary.fallback: If unequal exposure weights are known prospectively, use the weighted construction with a predeclared normalization cap; if the cap is exceeded, fail closed or begin a separately declared generation rather than retrospectively renormalizing.

implementation_sanity_not_proof.simulation: 30,000 trajectories, 500 top-level clusters, three adaptive/exogenous predictable-weight and conditional-mean patterns
implementation_sanity_not_proof.scope: Validity rests on the supermartingale-domination proof, not these simulations.

scope_guards: The unified portfolio is optimized on synthetic design grids, not production mismatch traffic.
Finite-grid and dense-stress no-regression are not an analytic continuum dominance theorem.
The weighted construction needs predictable weights; it does not justify outcome-dependent realized-size weighting.
Do not replace the current default portfolio until independent implementation tests and broader fractional/weight contracts are complete.
